title: ElevenLabs Subtitle Translator: what to check before choosing it
markdown:
If your decision is about translating subtitle files while retaining the ability to refine timing and export in familiar formats, ElevenLabs Subtitle Translator is worth evaluating against your actual workflow. Its product page says it can accept SRT, VTT, SUB, ASS, STL, and TXT files, and that subtitles can also be generated directly from audio or video. [ElevenLabs Subtitle Translator](https://elevenlabs.io/subtitle-translator)

The practical workflow described by ElevenLabs is: upload or generate captions, translate them, edit text or timing and merge segments when needed, then export the result. The page lists exports including SRT, VTT, TXT, DOCX, PDF, and JSON; its FAQ also lists HTML. Check that your destination platform accepts the format you plan to export before committing to the workflow. [ElevenLabs Subtitle Translator](https://elevenlabs.io/subtitle-translator)

For localization teams, the product page states support for translation into 150+ languages, batch processing, word-level timestamps, and optional dubbing. Those capabilities may suit podcasts, webinars, eLearning, or training material, but the appropriate choice still depends on the languages, file types, review process, and outputs your project requires. [ElevenLabs Subtitle Translator](https://elevenlabs.io/subtitle-translator)

Pricing should be checked separately from feature fit. ElevenLabs lists a Free plan at $0/month with 10,000 credits, Starter at $6/month with 30,000 credits, and other paid tiers; it also says credits are shared across products and prices exclude taxes, levies, and duties. Review the current plan details and expected credit use before subscribing. [ElevenLabs pricing](https://elevenlabs.io/pricing)

Disclosure: This article contains an affiliate link.

To review the tool’s current options and decide whether it matches your subtitle workflow, visit [ElevenLabs Subtitle Translator](https://try.elevenlabs.io/elevenlabs-discovered-subtitle-translator-en-1).
